reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from a ~600/month baseline to 1180 (Aug) and 1260 (Sep) 2026 (E-05), driven predominantly by incorrect bills on accounts with already-accepted ACTUAL meter reads — 59% (1785/3025) of disputed bills, not missing-read estimate substitution (E-02).
